redistribution_policy: Original article files are not redistributed. Checksums identify the exact remote files inspected on the retrieval date.

sources.citation: Corral, J. A. et al. Preparation of Palladium-Supported Periodic Mesoporous Organosilicas and their Use as Catalysts in the Suzuki Cross-Coupling Reaction. Materials 6 (2013) 1554-1565.
sources.facts_used: Methods: 1.0 g support, 0.03 g Pd(acac)2 in 5 mL acetone, reported 1.0 wt% Pd; Table 1: PMS pore volume 1.16 cm3/g.
sources.validation_scope: Audits both final-catalyst and support-relative interpretations because the loading denominator is not stated; compares both inverse calculations with the reported precursor mass and classifies the liquid-volume discrepancy.
sources.not_validated: Precursor assay, quantitative Pd retention, and the authors' intended loading denominator.

sources.citation: Mosallanejad, S. et al. On the Chemistry of Iron Oxide Supported on gamma-Alumina and Silica Catalysts. ACS Omega 3 (2018) 5362-5374.
sources.license: ACS AuthorChoice, non-commercial copying and redistribution terms stated in the article
sources.facts_used: Methods explicitly specify iron(III) nitrate nonahydrate, approximately 3 wt% Fe with respect to support mass, and incipient wetness; Table 1 reports 0.47 cm3/g pore volume for gamma-alumina.
sources.validation_scope: Scale-independent 1.000 g support benchmark for support-relative elemental loading, hydrate stoichiometry, and nominal IWI volume.
sources.not_validated: Commercial precursor mass because assay is not reported; actual solution volume because the method reports paste-like consistency rather than a measured volume.

sources.citation: Jiao, Y. et al. Nb2O5-gamma-Al2O3 nanofibers as heterogeneous catalysts for efficient conversion of glucose to 5-hydroxymethylfurfural. Scientific Reports 6 (2016) 34068.
sources.facts_used: Methods specify 0.5 g gamma-Al2O3, NbCl5, and controlled Nb2O5 loading defined as Nb2O5/(Nb2O5 + Al2O3); Table 2 gives 0.63 cm3/g pore volume for unloaded support; Table 1 separates controlled and ICP-AES real loadings.
sources.validation_scope: Final-catalyst-basis metal-oxide arithmetic for the controlled 10 wt% case and nominal pore-volume planning. The reported 4.7 wt% ICP-AES result is retained as an observation, not substituted for the preparation target.
sources.not_validated: Precursor assay, actual solution volume, oxalate speciation, Nb retention, or why controlled and ICP-AES loadings differ.

sources.citation: Karaca, H. et al. Intergranular and intragranular cobalt repartitions in alumina supported Fischer-Tropsch catalysts promoted with platinum. Comptes Rendus Chimie 12 (2009) 668-676.
sources.license: All rights reserved in the inspected published PDF
sources.facts_used: Methods specify Co(NO3)2*6H2O and Pt(NH3)4(NO3)2 co-impregnation, 0.477 cm3/g support pore volume, and 10 wt% Co plus 0.05 wt% Pt; catalyst labels designate elemental weight contents and the text explicitly refers to Pt in the final catalyst for the two-step series.
sources.validation_scope: Scale-independent 1.000 g support benchmark for coupled final-catalyst elemental loadings, two precursors sharing one nominal IWI liquid volume, and pure-precursor equivalents.
sources.not_validated: Commercial masses because precursor assays are not reported; measured precursor masses and actual solution volume are not reported.

sources.citation: Heikkinen, J. et al. Effect of Co-fed Water on a Co-Pt-Si/gamma-Al2O3 Fischer-Tropsch Catalyst Modified with an Atomic Layer Deposited or Molecular Layer Deposition Overcoating. ACS Omega 7 (2022) 7725-7736.
sources.facts_used: Candidate search only: Co/Pt twice, then Si, with nominal 21.4 wt% Co, 0.2 wt% Pt, 1.6 wt% Si and support pore volume 0.46 mL/g.
sources.validation_scope: None; retained in the failure register.
sources.not_validated: Loading denominator, support mass, per-cycle split, precursor assays, and actual liquid volumes are not reported sufficiently for an exact recipe regression.

sources.citation: Apuzzo, J., Cimino, S. & Lisi, L. Ni or Ru supported on MgO/gamma-Al2O3 pellets for the catalytic conversion of ethanol into butanol. RSC Advances 8 (2018) 25846-25855.
sources.facts_used: Candidate search only: MgO nominal 12 wt% and two-cycle 20 wt%; Ni and Ru nominal elemental loadings and 98.5% Ni precursor assay.
sources.validation_scope: None; retained in the failure register.
sources.not_validated: The source prints Ni(NO3)*6H2O and later Mg(NO3)*6H2O, so neutral precursor stoichiometry is not normalized without author correction; loading denominators, support mass, pore volume, liquid volume, and cycle split are also insufficiently specified.
